faq.question: Q1. Is the DBRAU engagement permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely temporary for the academic session 2026–27 and does not confer any right to regular appointment or continuation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application fee and how should it be paid?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs 1000/-, which must be submitted through a Demand Draft drawn in favour of Finance Officer, Dr Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Agra.

faq.question: Q3. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the University Guest House, Dr Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Khandari, Agra on 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Can application forms be submitted in advance via email?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates may email the duly filled application form along with supporting documents in advance to [email protected] for scrutiny up to 14 October 2026, while the original form, documents, and Demand Draft must be submitted at the interview.

faq.question: Q5. What documents must be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original certificates, marksheets, and documents along with one self-attested set for verification, plus the Demand Draft.
